hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$FILE" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac'
bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FILE" in *.ts) npx nx run-many -t typecheck 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac'

bash -c 'export AI_AGENT=1; FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FILE" in apps/api/*) npx nx test api -- related "${FILE#apps/api/}" --run 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; libs/shared/*) npx nx test shared -- related "${FILE#libs/shared/}" --run 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac'
